name: Oil Slick Iridescence
desc: Thin-film interference iridescence where a domain-warped thickness field bends light into slowly crawling spectral bands like petrol on wet asphalt, mapped through per-channel cosine interference; renders as dark saturated oil-on-water, airy soap-film pastel, metallic beetle-shell jewel, smooth thermal false-color, or pearlescent nacre.

warp.doc: domain-warp strength (higher = more folded turbulent slick)

orders.doc: interference order count (higher = more/tighter rainbow bands)

hue.doc: spectral base hue (where the rainbow starts)
